svg.title: Age of Renaissance — a map optimized for recognizing control, market size and commodity
svg.desc: A thirteen-province geographic study. Land tint and large capital shapes show ownership; white-faced pieces and diagonal hatching identify new placements. Market size and commodity share a compact badge. Area membership follows colored regional outlines. Coastal movement follows shared edges of pale coastal-water polygons. Those polygons touch exactly the seas and coastal neighbors in the catalog. Nine short arrows at land or water boundaries retain directed satellite support. Values and topology are verified; pieces and the geographic geometry are illustrative.
svg.text: Iberia & northwest Africa · sample game position

svg.text: Shared coastal-water edges allow a step; contact with a named sea shows sea access. Corner contact alone does neither.
New territory is hatched. Uncontrolled land stays neutral. Lock: The Heavens or Seaworthy Vessels. Illustrative geography and pieces.
